title: Red Hat Quay Repository
description: Schema for a container image repository in the Red Hat Quay registry, including its tags, visibility settings, and security scan information.

namespace.description: The namespace (organization or user) that owns the repository.

name.description: The name of the repository within the namespace.

description.description: A text description of the repository and its contents.

is_public.description: Whether the repository is publicly accessible without authentication.

is_starred.description: Whether the repository is starred by the authenticated user.

tag_count.description: The total number of tags in the repository.

tags.description: A map of tag names to tag details for the repository.

trust_enabled.description: Whether content trust (image signing) is enabled for the repository.

status_token.description: The token used for build status notifications.

can_write.description: Whether the authenticated user has write access to the repository.

can_admin.description: Whether the authenticated user has admin access to the repository.

Tag.description: A tag pointing to a specific image manifest in the repository.

manifest_digest.description: The SHA256 digest of the manifest the tag points to.

size.description: The compressed size of the image in bytes.

last_modified.description: The date and time the tag was last modified.

is_manifest_list.description: Whether this tag points to a multi-architecture manifest list.

reversion.description: Whether this tag was created by reverting to a previous image.

SecurityScan.description: Security scan results for a container image.

vulnerability_counts.description: Counts of vulnerabilities by severity level.
